tools.name: get_daily_summary
tools.description: Returns saved daily targets, quantity-weighted logged calories and macros, signed remaining and explicit overages for a strict user-local YYYY-MM-DD date. Missing or invalid nutrition is incomplete, never zero-filled; unknown totals and remaining are null. One shared diary call. No recommendations o

tools.name: get_nutrition_targets
tools.description: Returns only saved daily calories, protein, carbs, fat and fiber targets, with missing targets explicit. No recommendations or guessed goals. Requires meals:read and consumes one shared diary call.

tools.name: get_meals
tools.description: Returns a bounded page of the connected account’s private meals for a local calendar date, including persisted IDs and saved nutrition. Follow nextAfterId while hasMore is true. Oversized entries are marked for checking in Enshape; incomplete results must not be used as complete daily totals. Each p

tools.name: recent_foods
tools.description: Returns up to 50 recent private diary entries for the connected account, including their dates and saved nutrition.

tools.name: get_nearby_meal_suggestions
tools.description: Suggests meals at restaurants near coordinates the user provides, from meal combinations saved in Enshape. Returns at most 10 suggestions with restaurant address and distance, saved nutrition, serving info, component items and a nutritionSource for a later confirmed log_meal. Unpersonalized unless t

tools.name: update_nutrition_targets
tools.description: Changes only explicitly confirmed daily calories, protein, carbs, fat or fiber targets for the connected account. Omitted fields are preserved. Requires separate targets:write consent, at least one whole-number target, and confirmed:true. Returns the exact saved targets read back under the account l

tools.name: log_meal
tools.description: Creates one confirmed private diary entry for the connected account using per-serving nutrition and quantity. Requires all five nutrition values, source, local date and meal slot. Identical retries with the same requestId return the existing entry; changed payloads are rejected. Approved estimates a

tools.name: delete_meal
tools.description: Permanently deletes one persisted private diary entry belonging to the connected account after explicit user confirmation. Use the persisted ID from get_meals, recent_foods or log_meal; never a catalog ID or guessed ID. Confirm the exact entry before deletion. Retries of the same ID are safe: delete

tools.name: request_restaurant
tools.description: Stores a restaurant request in a private moderation inbox after explicit user confirmation. Requires restaurant name, a short message, and a stable requestId; optionally a coarse town or city. Never provide precise location, private contact details or diary content. tools.name: get_account_status
tools.description: Returns server-verified Premium status, diary tool usage, remaining Free allowance, UTC reset time and request caps for the connected account. An unavailable entitlement check reports unknown, never Premium. This lookup does not consume the diary allowance and remains subject to request rate limits.
